invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.18.0 preserves Parts 1–17, Kenya eTIMS, international e-invoicing, readable responsive surfaces and centralized opt-in tutorials, and adds Part 18 SaMi AI application depth without inventing a schema migration: permission-filtered receivables intelligence, invoice/customer/collections/recurring/fiscal read tools, confirmation-gated financial writes, and a narrow permission-checked Invoicing AI focus. The module schema remains 2.18.0 because Part 18 adds no tenant tables.
